text:
Maya: Morning all — quick sync on today's release train. 11:00 UTC slot needs smoke + rollback readiness. We're rolling model/service combo to v2.3 (traffic-split). Who's pairing on the canary? Ravi, can you confirm the DB migration is non-blocking? Also need CR LGTM from @Ashley by 09:30 UTC.
Leo: I can take the smoke for 11:00, I'll be oncall that slot. What checklist do you want? :thumbsup:
Maya: Thanks Leo. Basic smoke: api ping, /health, one small generation test (prompt: "status ping"), and run the smoke script: ./ci/smoke/ci-smoke.sh --env=staging. If you see >2% 5xxs kick rollback.
Ravi: DB migration is an ADD INDEX concurrently style change — no writes blocked. Ran it on staging, applied instantly. I'll stand by for replica lag or schema alerts.
Ashley: CR is LGTM, left a nit on a log string and pushed a tiny fix. @Maya I'm good with the rollout cadence if we do 10% -> 50% -> 100% with checks between.
Maya: Rollout cadence: start 10% at 11:00, observe for 5m. If p50 latency <=200ms and errors <=0.5% bump to 50% at ~11:15, then 100% at ~11:30. Any route crossing thresholds -> rollback.
Leo: Smoke command I'll run at 10:55 to precheck staging: ```./ci/smoke/ci-smoke.sh --env=staging --prompt='status ping' --timeout=60``` I'll paste short output here.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled for r-2026-03-18-v2.3 at 11:00 UTC. Tracking id: cr-7761.
Leo: Quick post-smoke: health OK, sample gen OK, p50 ~95ms, errors 0.1% — proceeding to 50%. Posting logs: `200 OK /health`, `gen_sample: PASS`.
Ashley: Dashboards look stable. Rollback steps ready: scale canary down, switch traffic to v2.2, revert feature flag in console. I'll take first action if error budgets breach.
Ravi: Monitoring DB metrics now, watching replica lag and write queue. Will alert if anything abnormal.
Maya: One last ask — attach a short eval prompt set to the rollout run so Optimize can baseline quality. I'll upload evals to the console by 10:45.
Leo: On it, will run the eval harness against the canary once 10% is live. Ping me to pause if you need to hold.
sre-oncall: I'll watch infra alerts and keep pager on during the window. Notify here if we need to escalate.
Maya: Thanks everyone. I'll post final rollout notes + timeline in the release doc after 11:30. :rocket:
